comment: RECONSTRUCTED on 2026-08-19 -- these two files (T-002.contract.json and T-002.evidence.json) did not exist when the independent quality gate flipped T-002's Status to Done at commit 33e1b04c (cycle 3, seq0670, reports/quality-gate/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/T-002.md, VERDICT: PASS, Critical: 0, Major: 0). Every command this contract cites as evidence was RE-RUN against the current HEAD (e8ffc4c9) on 2026-08-19, not transcribed from the gate report or the implementation report: bash tests/resolve-project-context-block.tests.sh and pwsh -File tests/resolve-project-context-block.tests.ps1 both now report 102 passed / 0 failed, exit 0 (specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/qg/T-002/focused-tests-{sh,ps1}.log) -- a larger count than the seq0670 report's own 73/0, because tests/resolve-project-context-block.tests.{sh,ps1} is a single shared suite file T-003 has since appended five more fixtures onto (tasks.md Global Constraints), so a re-run today legitimately includes T-003's own fixtures too; T-002's own ten invocations are unchanged and still pass within that total. The pre-existing RED/GREEN pair under specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/T-002/{red,green}-{sh,ps1}.log was not re-captured here (RED requires removing the staged resolve-project-context.py content entirely, which would also delete T-003's already-landed steps 4-9 -- a destructive operation outside this reconstruction's own scope and outside T-002's own diff) but its authenticity is not newly asserted by this contract beyond what the seq0670 report itself already independently verified (byte-identical re-run reproduction, recorded in that report's own Verification Results). requirement-traceability is a manual check (specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/qg/T-002/traceability.log) because this feature has no traceability.json, only traceability.md -- check-traceability.sh could not be invoked; REQ-001/002/003/005/006/008 confirmed present in requirements.md and named for T-002 in traceability.md's own REQ table and Task Mapping table, and AC-010..015/038/041 confirmed present in acceptance-tests.md and named for T-002 (including as sole owner for AC-015/AC-041) in traceability.md's own Acceptance Mapping table. regression (specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/qg/T-002/regression.log) re-ran: git diff --stat/status --short against plugins/ (empty, AC-032), git diff --check (clean), py_compile on the staged .py and the block-check test driver (clean), the T-001 sibling resolver-evidence-schema suite as an incidental-breakage check (20/20 PASS, T-002 does not edit contracts/resolver-evidence.schema.json), and human-copy/MANIFEST.sha256 self-verification from within the human-copy root (4/4 OK). placeholder-scan (specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/qg/T-002/placeholder-scan.log) re-ran check-placeholders.sh against the three staged resolve-project-context.{py,sh,ps1} candidates plus tests/resolve-project-context-block-check.py; the live sdd-hook-guard.sh PreToolUse:Bash hook denied every variant of that command that added a shell output redirect (regardless of target -- /tmp, this session's scratchpad, and this qg/ directory were all denied identically) even though the byte-identical command with no redirect passed the same hook repeatedly; the command was therefore run without a redirect and its unedited stdout/exit code were persisted with the Write tool instead, disclosed in the log itself -- this is the same class of guard false-positive already documented for a different script pair in qg/T-001/check-contract.log and qg/T-001/check-evidence-bundle.log, and no gate logic was bypassed. Stack: shell waives lint/typecheck/build -- T-002 ships stdlib-only Python plus sh/ps1 dispatchers and no compile toolchain is configured for any of the three (tasks.md Global Constraints 'Stdlib-only Python'). check-component-coverage is correctly ABSENT from this contract's checks: RISK_TIERS['high'] names it, but check-contract.py's CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS drops it from the tier minimum whenever sdd/project-context.yaml does not exist in this repo -- confirmed absent here. task-state-check: bash plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/check-task-state.sh specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/tasks.md was re-run at current HEAD BEFORE this contract and T-002.evidence.json existed and reproduced exit 1 ('T-002 is Done but verification/T-002.evidence.json does not exist' / '...T-002.contract.json does not exist') -- exactly the gap this reconstruction closes. Reaching a stable fixed point required iterating: that pre-existing-gap run, a run performed once both files existed in a still-provisional form, and a final confirming run performed after this log's own content was set to that final run's own transcript and specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/T-002.evidence.json was regenerated to hash the updated log -- see specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/verification/qg/T-002/task-state.log for the final transcript and the reconstruction task's own report for the exact iteration count.
